title: Inspect the agent evaluation system
description: Switch scenarios to see why outcome claims, tool logs, policy checks, and external-state verification must be evaluated together.

nodes.label: Scenario runner
nodes.detail: Defines the goal, initial state, available tools, budgets, prohibited actions, and success checks.

nodes.label: Agent under test
nodes.detail: Observes the environment, selects tools, updates its plan, and emits claims about progress.

nodes.label: Tool policy gateway
nodes.detail: Validates arguments, identity, permissions, approvals, and budgets before any external action.

nodes.label: Test environment
nodes.detail: Executes approved actions and exposes the authoritative state used to determine whether the task actually completed.

nodes.label: Outcome verifier
nodes.detail: Compares the final environment state with the goal and detects partial, duplicate, or falsely reported completion.

nodes.label: Trajectory store
nodes.detail: Records observations, model and prompt versions, proposed actions, tool results, policy decisions, timing, and cost.

nodes.label: Trajectory scorer
nodes.detail: Scores planning, efficiency, recovery, evidence use, and policy compliance across the complete trace.

scenarios.label: Successful run
scenarios.summary: The agent uses an approved tool, observes the result, and the independent verifier confirms the requested state.
scenarios.result: Goal completion, policy compliance, and the external state agree; the trajectory remains available for diagnosis.

scenarios.label: Tool failure
scenarios.summary: The approved tool fails, so the agent must interpret a typed error and recover without duplicating a side effect.
scenarios.result: The run receives recovery and efficiency scores; a polished final answer cannot erase repeated or unsafe retries.

scenarios.label: Blocked action
scenarios.summary: The agent proposes an action outside its permissions. The gateway rejects it before the environment changes.
scenarios.result: The system remains safe, but the trajectory records a policy violation and the task is not scored as successfully completed.

scenarios.label: False completion
scenarios.summary: The agent claims success even though the authoritative environment does not contain the requested state.
scenarios.result: Independent state verification marks the task incomplete and prevents self-reported success from inflating the score.
